notes: Emoji with a clear meaning (🤥 lying face, 🤫 shushing, 🤐 zipped mouth, 🔇 mute, 🔐 lock, 🫢 hand over mouth) are kept as family members. Families about the listener's reaction (sceptical, suspicion, challenge, accuse, evidence, contradict, rumour) and about stance (protect, reassure, persuade, confident, avoid) are given side 'unclear'. Strategy words (策略, रणनीति, стратегия) and emotion emoji (😓, 😬, 😰) were not made families. Rejected matches for obvious non-words (Client, Allies, anschließend, resiliency) are not listed.
